query:
select
md.medication as "Medication",
md.medication_code as "Code",
sum(md.quantity) as "Quantity"
from "reporting"."ds__medication_dispenses" md
where
case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else md.facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
and
case
when 
:medicationId is null then true
else md.medication_id = 
:medicationId
end
and
((md.dispensed_at at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
>= 
:fromDate
and
((md.dispensed_at at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney'))
<= 
:toDate
group by md.medication_id, md.medication, md.medication_code
name: Medication dispensed summary
notes: This report shows quantity of medication dispensed for a given drug within a specified date range, based on dispense records.
